origin.description: An order that puts equal values into contiguous blocks.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: An integer, real, or character vector.

origin.details: The groups follow the first time each value appears, the same order as unique(). Inside a group the original positions stay in order. -0 is the same real as 0.
origin.value: A 1-based integer permutation. x at those positions has contiguous groups.
